verdict.rationale: No evidence describes a dedicated bulk or batch feature. Bulk processing is only implied: workflows can run arbitrary Node.js, Python, Go or Bash code with any npm package, so a user could loop over many items in custom code. The REST API can also manage workflows and sources programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch operation or loop step, multi-item selection in the UI or agent tools, batch API endpoints, and any hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.
